# Inertia show page

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A show method passes one record's ViewModel to resources/js/pages/<Area>/Show/Page.vue; dates render relative to the viewer's timezone, never by hand.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make page --flavor=show <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui Page, @kit/ui SectionHeader, @kit/ui Section, @kit/ui ActionBar.
- `Page` from `@kit/ui` for the page shell: Wraps the record page (props: title).
- `SectionHeader` from `@kit/ui` for the header: Record title and its actions (props: title, actions slot).
- `Section` from `@kit/ui` for the details: Groups the record fields (props: title).
- `ActionBar` from `@kit/ui` for the actions: Record actions placed by the kit (props: actions descriptors).
- `ButtonGroup` from `@kit/ui` for the button set: Related buttons side by side (props: default slot).
Checks: 20, 21, descriptors, js-imports. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "What does the page mainly do?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.show` to see its siblings.
